label: Failing to report a change of stay address: the penalty
appliesTo: Registered foreign nationals who do not report a change of stay address within the deadline
why: Recorded because almost every English-language moving checklist calls this an administrative fine, and it is not one. It is a criminal fine under the Immigration Act — a different legal character with different consequences for someone whose residence status is reviewed on their record. The amount matters less than the category.

history.note: A criminal fine (벌금), not an administrative fine (과태료). Failure to report other changes to alien registration particulars sits under different provisions with a different enforcement structure, so the two should not be quoted as one rule. For a person whose visa extension or status change is assessed partly on compliance history, the classification is the part that carries weight.
